scope: Generic OBD-II definitions and manufacturer coverage metadata. Model-specific support requires validated definitions.

protocols.name: ISO 15765-4 CAN
protocols.notes: Common OBD-II CAN transport; addressing and bitrate are vehicle-dependent.

protocols.name: ISO 14229 UDS
protocols.notes: Modern diagnostic application protocol; services and security are ECU-specific.

standard_obd_modes.name: Vehicle information including VIN where supported

uds_service_catalogue.name: SecurityAccess
uds_service_catalogue.note: Requires authorised credentials and documented integration.

uds_service_catalogue.name: InputOutputControlByIdentifier
uds_service_catalogue.note: Actuator control; excluded from generic execution.

uds_service_catalogue.name: RoutineControl
uds_service_catalogue.note: Can initiate ECU routines; excluded from generic execution.

remote_start_policy.reason: No universal remote-start frame or security credential exists across vehicle makes and models.
remote_start_policy.allowed_implementation: Authenticated controller integration with independently verified safety interlocks.
excluded: Guessed security keys or seed/key algorithms

adapter_notes: Bluetooth Classic SPP supported by this starter; BLE transport not implemented.
Generic OBD-II does not expose every vehicle module.
